description: Defines data structures and classes for managing E1AP UE contexts and their identifiers within a gNB-CU-UP component, including context list management, UE ID handling, and context creation/removal.

classes.name: e1ap_ue_context_list
classes.description: Manages a list of UE contexts, providing methods to add, remove, and find UE contexts by various identifiers, and to generate the next available UE ID.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a UE with the given CU-UP-UE-E1AP-ID exists in the list.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a UE with the given UE index exists in the list.

methods.name: find_ue
methods.description: Finds and returns a pointer to the UE context with the specified CU-UP-UE-E1AP-ID.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses the UE context by CU-UP-UE-E1AP-ID or UE index, asserting existence.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE context with specified identifiers and activity level.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE context by UE index.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of UE contexts stored.

methods.name: next_gnb_cu_up_ue_e1ap_id
methods.description: Generates the next available CU-UP-UE-E1AP-ID, reusing IDs if necessary.
